children: TEL AVIV, Israel and HANNOVER, Germany, Sept. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
Electreon Wireless Ltd
), a global leader in wireless charging solutions for electric vehicles, will present Electreon Lite DOT for the first time at IAA Transportation in Hannover from 14 to 20 September 2026 -

a new stationary wireless charging solution for passenger cars and light commercial vehicles. Based on Electreon's proven, field-tested wireless charging technology, Lite DOT makes charging electric vehicles as simple as parking.

"The future of electric mobility is wireless, and it will soon be available in every parking space," says Oren Ezer, Chairman and CEO of Electreon. "With Lite DOT, we are introducing a new category to the market: powerful, modular charging that can be installed without any modifications to existing infrastructure. The strong interest from international automakers and leading suppliers demonstrates that the industry is ready for the next stage of development."
Simply park and charge automatically

Lite DOT simplifies the charging process for electric passenger cars and light commercial vehicles, including autonomous vehicles, making it more convenient and efficient for both fleet operators and private users. No more cumbersome handling of charging cables     . Once the vehicle is parked, the system identifies it and charging starts automatically and immediately.

Lite DOT delivers up to 11 kilowatts (kW) of charging power, matching the current standard for private charging connections. The system can be installed safely both outdoors and inside garages. It operates efficiently and reliably in rain and snow, and at temperatures ranging from -30 to +50 degrees Celsius (-22 to +122 degrees Fahrenheit).

Lite DOT consists of a charging pad that is installed above ground on a parking space without the need for extensive excavation work, as well as a wall unit that can be mounted either on a garage wall or outdoors, for example on a pole, and the Electreon Flow driver mobile application. The solution is designed to operate with a vehicle-specific receiver supplied either by Electreon itself or by partners from the automotive industry.
Charging becomes part of regular parking times for electric fleets

Conventional charging solutions often still hinder the efficient and smooth operation of electric fleets. One key reason is the reliance on cables. Frequent plugging and unplugging, combined with daily handling and exposure to dirt and weather, and in many cases mistakenly being run over by the vehicles, makes charging cables and connectors among the most wear and tear maintenance-intensive components of conventional EV charging infrastructure.

"Fleet operators need flexible and scalable charging concepts that can be easily installed at their sites and parking facilities and integrated seamlessly into day-to-day operations," explains Dr Andreas Wendt, Managing Director of Electreon Germany. "Electreon Lite DOT offers exactly that and enables fleet operators to charge wirelessly during regular parking periods."
The future of electric mobility is wireless

The market launch of Lite DOT comes at a time when electric mobility continues to gain momentum worldwide and across Europe. In the first half of 2026 alone, registrations of electric vehicles in Europe increased by over 30 percent. According to estimates by the International Energy Agency (IEA), electric vehicles could account for around 40 percent of global new car sales by 2030, requiring approximately 150 million additional charging points by the end of the decade.

Whether wired technologies can be replaced by wireless solutions, the more convenient wireless alternative will prevail in the long term. Just as Wi-Fi replaced network cables and Bluetooth replaced other physical connections. Electreon is continuing to strengthen its position as a provider of wireless charging solutions with Lite DOT. Its presentation at IAA Transportation 2026 marks the beginning of the rollout of Electreon's new wireless charging product that underlines the company's vision: electric mobility should become as simple as parking itself – automated, efficient and cable-free.
About Electreon

Electreon is a global leader in wireless electric vehicle (EV) charging technology, providing integrated solutions for stationary, semi-dynamic, and dynamic (in-road) charging applications. Its product portfolio including LINE (dynamic charging), DASH (opportunity charging), DOT (charging while idle), and a vehicle-agnostic receiver platform supports a wide range of commercial fleet use cases, enabling charging to become a seamless part of daily operations.

With more than 20 projects across Europe, Asia, and North America, Electreon's technology eliminates the need for plugs and cables, enabling automated charging for buses, trucks, vans, passenger vehicles, and autonomous mobility solutions. Live deployments include the world's first wireless charging highway and the world's first 24/7 wireless charging bus depot.

Following the acquisition of InductEV in 2026, Electreon now holds nearly 400+ patents and offers one of the industry's most comprehensive wireless charging portfolios. The company is committed to advancing sustainable transportation by making wireless charging infrastructure an integral part of the future mobility ecosystem.
